svg.aria-label: A name's life by who holds it: a free name is paid for in the app or the browser, or bought on the site; a site-bought name moves into the app's wallet with its name code; in the app's wallet its owner can point it at any link, also outside the app, give it to another profile, restore it on a new phone, or transfer it to another person; an unrenewed name has 90 days of grace and is then free again.
svg.text: give it to another profile · v1.1
restore it on a new phone
pay in app or browser · v1
or paste a prepaid code · v1
name code moves it in · v1
in the term or the grace
after the grace: anyone can register it
